title: Replace instances of wmem_alloc with wmem_new
description:
This commit replaces instances of
`(myobj *)wmem_alloc(wmem_file_scope(), sizeof(myobj))`
with `wmem_new(wmem_file_scope(), myobj)`
to improve the readability of Wireshark's code.

Replacements were made with the following Python script:

```
import os
import re
import sys

print_replacement_info = True

patterns = [
(r'\(([^\s\n]+)\s*\*\)\s*wmem_alloc(0?)\s*\(\s*([_a-z\(\)->]+),\s*sizeof\s*\(\1\)\)', r'wmem_new\2(\3, \1)'),

(r'\((struct\s+[^\s\n]+)\s*\*\)\s*wmem_alloc(0?)\s*\(\s*([_a-z\(\)->]+),\s*sizeof\s*\(\1\)\)', r'wmem_new\2(\3, \1)'),

]

def main():
    startdir = sys.argv[1]

    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(startdir):
        for fname in files:
            fpath = os.path.join(root, fname)
            if not (fpath.endswith('.c') or fpath.endswith('.cpp')):
                continue
            with open(fpath, 'r') as fh:
                fdata_orig = fh.read()
            fdata = fdata_orig
            for pattern, replacewith in patterns:
                fdata_out = re.sub(pattern, replacewith, fdata)
                if print_replacement_info and fdata != fdata_out:
                    print("In %s, %s made replacements!" % (fpath, pattern))
                fdata = fdata_out
            if fdata != fdata_orig:
                print(fpath)
                with open(fpath, 'w') as fh:
                    fh.write(fdata)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

notes.body: Note: This is a slightly enhanced rerun of https://code.wireshark.org/review/#/c/38088/
